svg.text: Date filter proves 'last year' works: INC-2024-031 (Nov 2024) and
INC-2026-002 (Feb 2026) must NOT appear. MTG-001 cross-checks:
'three of eight payment outages' = pool exhaustion.
Viewer: plan finds 0 docs -> falls back to hybrid search over its 2 public
docs -> answer should state the evidence is insufficient.
Recursive reduce when batches > 4 (shown if BATCH_CHARS lowered)
depth 0: 8 partials -> 2 groups of 4 (parallel) -> depth 1: merge 2 -> aggregate
With the default 5000-char batch, demo has 2 partials -> a single merge.
RLM degradation paths (never fails the whole turn)
Plan LLM down / bad JSON / unsafe code / 0 ids
-> plan_fallback event -> hybrid search top-20 docs
-> not 'forbidden': simply invisible to the plan
Expected LangSmith trace for the RLM question (one trace per turn)
